payloadSchema.title: ocr.text@1
payloadSchema.description: Complete extracted text for one document. The text is the blob (UTF-8); this payload describes it. The blob-backed form never duplicates the text in JSON.

notes: Blob policy is required, not optional: one registered type version cannot have an undecided blob policy. Bounded inline text for short scans would be a separate type.
text-range locators into this blob count Unicode code points; the canonicalizer's NFC rule is what keeps those offsets valid across the store.
engine is duplicated from the run receipt only when downstream code branches on it.
